scripts.verify: npm run verify:lockfile && npm run verify:types && npm run lint && npm run test --workspace=@vtk/web && npm run test --workspace=@vtk/logistiek
scripts.verify:types: npm run db:generate && npm exec --workspace=@vtk/web -- next typegen && npm exec --workspace=@vtk/logistiek -- next typegen && npm exec --workspace=@vtk/fakbar -- next typegen && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.build.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/logistiek/tsconfig.build.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/fakbar/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@vtk/db && npm run build --workspace=@vtk/web
scripts.app:check: npm run type-check --prefix mobile && npm run lint --prefix mobile && npm run routes:check --prefix mobile
